title.narrative: In 2024 UNICEF and partners made progress toward addressing the needs of children affected by armed conflict, including the release of 3,784 children from military custody and armed groups, verification of 2,200 grave violations against 937 children and the elevation of children’s voices through research and advocacy for reintegration policies.
